name: 云文档协同编辑
description: Cloud-document co-editing on a mandate harness: receipts with before-images, one-click revert, permission floors, unattended comment handling.

display_description.en: Install to add cloud-document co-editing (Google Docs/Sheets, Feishu) with its mandate harness: every write leaves a receipt, any batch reverts in one click, assigned comments can run unattended. After installing, wire a connection in Settings → Cloud Docs; safeguards switch on the Docs panel.
display_description.zh: 安装后获得云文档协同编辑（Google 文档/表格、飞书）及其委托机制：每笔写入留回执、一键整批回退、批注指派可无人值守处理。装好后到 Settings → Cloud Docs 接入连接；保障开关在 Docs 面板。
